items.title: Ship Lattice CLI 0.3.5 product identity and entrypoint
items.context: Add a first-class lattice command/branding while preserving koala as a legacy compatibility alias. Version/help/package metadata must make Lattice CLI the current product name without breaking existing local Koala commands.
items.userSees: 用户运行 `lattice --version` 看到 `Lattice CLI 0.3.5`；运行 `koala --version` 仍显示兼容入口并可继续使用旧命令。

edge.desc: koala legacy alias still exposes the command catalog.

adversarial.desc: bootstrap/help text does not require Mac App setup for CLI usage.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke asserts `lattice --version`, package versions, lattice bin mapping, and Lattice CLI 0.3.5 help identity.
Smoke asserts the legacy koala alias remains present through package bin and version/help compatibility text.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "Mac App|Primary path|Lattice CLI 0.3.5|legacy alias" README.md docs/requirements/decisions/*.md
verificationEvidence.note: Docs state Lattice CLI is primary, koala is legacy, and Mac App is optional/archive dashboard only rather than setup requirement.

items.title: Expose Mac App provider/config capabilities through CLI surfaces
items.context: Move the useful Mac App provider status and preference concepts into CLI commands: host probe/install guidance, Lattice/Koala config compatibility, and visible deprecation of Mac-only provider dashboard behavior.
items.userSees: 用户运行 `lattice host list`、`lattice host probe --host=codex` 和 `lattice config doctor` 看到 provider/config 状态与降级提示，不需要打开 Mac App provider dashboard。

happy.desc: host list/probe and config doctor return Lattice CLI provider/config status.

edge.desc: missing optional providers are reported as visible degradations, not fatal errors.

adversarial.desc: host install guidance is dry-run guidance and does not execute third-party installs.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke asserts host_list, host_probe, host_install, and lattice_config_doctor are in MAIN_TOOLS, registry, read-only policy, DEV allowlist, and JSON behavior.
Smoke probes Codex and migration status through JSON surfaces that expose capability/degradation status without fatal provider dashboard dependency.
Smoke asserts host_install returns dryRun=true, executed=false, and thirdPartyInstallsExecuted=false.

items.title: Define receipt-aware authority and conduit semantics without creating a new agent host
items.context: Add CLI-visible authority/conduit status and docs that distinguish third-party hosts from Lattice Conduit. Lattice Conduit is a thin job conduit/event capture path, not a model runner or production authority.
items.userSees: 用户运行 `lattice authority status` 和 `lattice conduit status` 看到 Server Authority receipts 是唯一生产权威，Conduit 只是 thin conduit，不是 agent host。

happy.desc: authority/conduit status commands expose receipt-aware, non-authoritative local status.

edge.desc: missing authority URL yields guidance without claiming receipt verification.

adversarial.desc: local JSON, handoff packs, conduit status, and transport acceptance cannot be reported as production DONE.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke asserts authority_status and conduit_status return receipt-aware local status with receiptVerified=false and productionDone=false.
Smoke covers missing/default authority URL behavior via authority_status JSON where serverReachability is not-probed and no receipt verification is claimed.
Smoke recursively fails if productionDone, receiptVerified, canClaimProductionDone, or authorityChanged become true in local CLI surfaces.

items.title: Demote Mac App from required release path
items.context: Update product docs and runtime messaging so Mac App is optional/archive/dashboard only; Lattice CLI + Server Authority receipts becomes the main path. Do not rely on Mac App for CLI release or host-neutral workflow usage.
items.userSees: 用户在 README 顶部看到 `Lattice CLI 0.3.5`；在迁移说明中看到精确文字 `Mac App: optional/archive dashboard only` 和 `Primary path: Lattice CLI + Server Authority receipts`。

happy.desc: docs state Lattice CLI works with third-party hosts and Server Authority receipts.

edge.desc: docs keep Koala as legacy compatibility wording without confusing the main product identity.

adversarial.desc: docs do not imply Mac App must be open-sourced or installed to use Lattice CLI.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "Primary path: Lattice CLI \+ Server Authority receipts|Mac App:|optional/archive dashboard only" README.md docs/requirements/decisions/*.md
verificationEvidence.note: README and decision docs state the primary path is Lattice CLI plus Server Authority receipts, with Mac App optional/archive dashboard only.
Docs preserve koala as legacy compatibility wording while making Lattice CLI 0.3.5 the primary product entrypoint.
Docs explicitly demote Mac App and do not require it to be open-sourced or installed for Lattice CLI usage.

items.title: Verify Lattice CLI migration with focused build and smoke tests
items.context: Add focused smoke coverage for lattice entrypoint/version/help, legacy koala alias compatibility, host/config/authority/conduit command exposure, and no production authority overclaim from local CLI surfaces.
items.userSees: 用户看到 `npm run build` 和 `npm run test:lattice-cli-migration-smoke` 通过，并且 checklist verificationEvidence 覆盖所有 happy/edge/adversarial intent。

happy.desc: build and focused Lattice CLI migration smoke test pass.

edge.desc: smoke covers missing optional hosts and missing authority URL fallback output.

adversarial.desc: smoke fails if any local CLI surface overclaims verified production receipt authority.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm run test:lattice-cli-migration-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Final HEAD build and focused Lattice CLI migration smoke both passed.
Smoke covers optional host/config defaults and missing authority URL fallback without failing the command.
Smoke fails on any local CLI overclaim of verified production receipt authority across host/config/authority/conduit JSON surfaces.
